title: Chapter 314 Mysterious Phantom
content:
Chapter 314 Mysterious Phantom

At the same time, several forces finally arrived outside the Bronze Palace after a long journey.

"Ye Wuwei!"

"Ye Tian!"

"Chu Xingyue!"

The three of them looked at each other, their eyes full of shock.

Ye Tian is the first person in the Ye clan’s younger generation this year and the leader of the entire Ye clan’s younger generation.

He was even given supreme high hopes by the Ye clan.

Chu Xingyue is the proud daughter of the Chu clan and is also the first person in the younger generation.

Obviously, the three of them know each other.

"Ye Wuwei, I knew you had a way to enter the ancient battlefield."

Ye Tian looked at Ye Wuwei and said coldly.

Regarding the ancient battlefield, Ye Tian has always regarded it as their private property of the Ye tribe.

The other three ancient tribes are a little better, but when he meets other people on the ancient battlefield, he will show extreme hatred.

However, Ye Tian has not taken action now, which is enough to prove Ye Wuwei's strength.

"Haha, Ye Tian, you really think that this ancient battlefield was opened by your family, and after all, my surname is Ye."

Looking at Ye Tian in the distance, Ye Wuwei said disdainfully.

Hearing this, Ye Tian spat directly.

"I am the noble ancient leaf tribe, and you deserve to be compared with me?"

Just as the two wanted to continue arguing, Chu Xingyue suddenly spoke and interrupted the conversation between them.

Chu Xingyue is tall and has an extremely delicate face. In addition, she is the proud daughter of the ancient Chu clan, and she is almost always flattering to her.

However, Chu Xingyue not only did not lose herself in these praises, but also awakened the emperor's heart at the Immortal Saint Realm and shocked countless immortals.

That's the Emperor's Heart, even many powerful people in the Immortal Emperor Realm do not have it.

Once the emperor's heart is awakened early, it is no exaggeration to say that becoming emperor is already a foregone conclusion.

Facing such a woman, whether it is Ye Wuwei or Ye Tian, they are all a little afraid and admiration.

"The purpose of everyone must be the same."

Chu Xingyue looked at the two of them and said lightly.

Upon hearing this, Ye Wuwei and Ye Tian didn't say anything, but their snarky eyes looked at the bronze palace beside them intentionally or unintentionally.

There was still a hint of greed in his eyes.

"Xingyue, this bronze palace is in the ancient battlefield, and the ancient battlefield is the place of trial for the ancient family. It is better for you and I to join forces to clear these outsiders first, and then make a decision on the rest. How about it?"

Ye Tian looked at Chu Xingyue with a cold face in the distance and said.

Hearing this, Chu Xingyue frowned slightly, because Ye Tian called her Xingyue, which made her feel a little disgusted.

Although this is not the first time.

After all, their Chu tribe has a good relationship with the Ye tribe, and even the elders in their tribe are interested in matching them.

But Chu Xingyue was obviously not very happy.

In the distance, Ye Wuwei looked at Chu Xingyue without saying anything, thinking that he was hesitating, and couldn't help but get angry.

I am a destiny person, and you are actually thinking of uniting and excluding me.

Haha, I really don’t know the world is high.

He didn't know that at this time, Ye Tian was also sneering in his heart.

With my identity as a destiny, once Ye Wuwei is eliminated, then only me and Xingyue are left, and maybe you can collect the beauty and treasures together.

Hahaha, I'm such a genius.

On the other side, Chu Xingyue's brows gradually stretched.

If that handsome guy didn't lie to me, then the biggest gain in this bronze palace must be me.

But now it seems that the competition is a bit fierce, and I believe that it is more than the three of us.

Thinking of this, Chu Xingyue looked at Ye Tian and said, "Ye Tian, we cooperate, but I will first agree that we must divide the treasures in the Bronze Palace equally, and once we leave the Bronze Palace, our cooperation will end."

As soon as Ye Tian said this, before Ye Tian could react, a faint light rushed into the bronze palace.

"Damn it, let this kid run away!"

Standing there, Ye Tian looked ugly.

"Xingyue, just as you said, we will go in."

"good."

Immediately, Ye Tian and Chu Xingyue also rushed into the Bronze Palace.

And after a moment, another force came outside the Bronze Palace.

"That's it?"

Tang Hao looked at the huge bronze palace in front of him, and a hint of surprise appeared in his eyes.

Haha, Qin Feng did not lie to him.

He naturally only believed Qin Feng’s words halfway.

And the reason why he came was to seize Chen Mingyu's opportunity.

He didn't want to wait for Chen Mingyu to gain a lot and then surpass himself.

"It seems that there are many crises inside. After entering, I can't guarantee that I can protect you. You can decide whether to enter or not."

After saying that, Tang Hao stopped caring about everyone and rushed into the Bronze Palace.

He naturally didn't want to lead the colleagues from the academies behind him.

He doesn't want to always have a bunch of flaws.

Not only did he think so, but also Ye Wuwei and others.

The more dangerous the place, the fewer the number of people, the more convenient it is.

Ye Wuwei, Ye Tian and Chu Xingyue all entered alone.

As for why Chen Mingyu still had to take four people, it is unknown.

When they were in place, everyone began to think.

The two chose to leave here, while the remaining four people all chose to rush into the Bronze Palace.

"My master, let's go in as soon as possible."

Ao Qing pulled Lu Xue's pretty face and said anxiously.

He didn't want to wait in and nothing happened.

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded, "Let's go too."

Xiao Luo and Qin Feng did not hesitate and directly followed Lu Xue into the Bronze Palace.

A moment later, a figure slowly emerged from outside the bronze palace.

"This bronze palace is really meaningful."

Looking at the bronze palace in front of him, Lu Daosheng suddenly smiled faintly.

At this time, a hidden sound suddenly sounded deep in the bronze palace.

This sound seemed to have crossed time and space and reached Lu Daosheng's ears.

Upon hearing this, a look of surprise appeared in Lu Daosheng's face.

The owner of this bronze palace actually took the initiative to invite him.

"interesting."

As Lu Daosheng's body trembled, his figure suddenly disappeared from the spot.

"Fellow Daoist, you are not simple."

Deep in the bronze palace, in a large room.

Lu Daosheng suddenly appeared here. When he saw a bronze seat with cumbersome runes on it, he even had a crown engraved on the backrest.

Hearing the voice, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Is there anything wrong with you looking for me?"

The next moment, the space in front of Lu Daosheng trembled slightly.

Immediately afterwards, an illusory figure slowly emerged.

He couldn't see his face clearly, but he could only see a bronze mask on his face.

"Fellow Daoist, are you interested in my palace?"

“Not interested.”

Phantom:...

For a moment, the phantom didn't know what to say.

Why doesn't this guy in front of me play by the routine?

"Are you the guardian of one of those little guys?"

The phantom asked again.
